gettingStarted.title: New here? Start with one free lesson.
gettingStarted.description: Begin with bubble sort: watch adjacent numbers swap, try a different input, then check your understanding. No account or payment needed to begin.
gettingStarted.step1: 1. Watch the animation. Use Play, Pause and Step to follow each operation.
gettingStarted.step2: 2. Try it yourself. Change the input and answer the prediction challenge.
gettingStarted.step3: 3. Check your understanding. Take the quiz, then explore arrays and Big O.
gettingStarted.account: Sign in to sync your learning across devices. Free lessons are labelled Free; other lessons require all-access.
